summary: devcli config/runtime/diff found undeclared env overriding declared security config, then auto-wrote docs and reloaded a service. Live metrics and auto-reconcile are magic. The residue matches hdd-debug: declared vs actual, plus the undeclared override as a first-class conflict source.
preserve_add: The mismatch was not 'wrong YAML' but an undeclared environment variable overriding a declared policy.
diff expected:config.yaml actual:runtime named conflict sources.
established_add: Commands: devcli, config audit, runtime query, diff expected:config.yaml actual:runtime, config reconcile --fix=document.
rejected_add: Live metrics 12%/88% over 15m, auth-service@v1.3, auto-created markdown files, and a reload that made enforcement 100% are not observations.
constraints_add: There is no live application, metric stream, or reload RPC.
The CLI cannot write documentation to 'fix' drift. It may only report it.
No hidden feature-flag registry. Sources of override must be files or process environment actually present.
open_questions_add: Can the tool name undeclared overrides (env vars, defaults) that explain config-vs-actual without talking to a running service?
harvest_candidates_add: Diff declared configuration against actual effective configuration, listing undeclared override sources.
pressure: There is no live process and no metrics API. Continue using the same CLI on files and environment variables in a real tree.
The CLI cannot repair, document, or reload anything. Report only.
A useful result names the undeclared override source (file, env, default) without inventing percentages.
